events.summary: Add Thu+Sun evenings: 55.2 ± 3.6 vs 41.5 ± 3.8 for current practice (residents (of the sample) who visit libraries in a week). E3 wins on the target metric: 55.2 ± 3.6 weekly library visitors versus 41.5 ± 3.8 for current practice, a gain of about 13.7 points. It also beats the other done options in both the main sample (E1 46.4, E2 49.1, OS 46.5, SW 53.0) and all held-out tests (54.0, 56.625, 49.75 across A/B/C). Budget (budget of town-run places (Hood River City Hall, Hood River Library, Overlook Memorial Park, Winans Park)): $477.6k/yr (+$31.2k vs current; wage $25/h from model default ($25/staff hour incl. benefits)).
events.assumptions: The result depends on the synthetic resident schedules, arrival rates, and word-of-mouth defaults, plus the model-coded notice channels. The measured means/uncertainties are taken as reliable, and no budget limit is assumed.
events.pilot: Run a 6–8 week pilot at Hood River Library with Thu 10:00–21:00 and Sun 12:00–18:00, using online and in-building notice. Measure weekly unique visitors, repeat visits, and evening/weekend checkouts against the pre-pilot baseline, with a simple headcount and circulation log each open day.
